// CompanyDatabases note: Server-side allow-list of SAP B1 companies this portal exposes to the login dropdown. Contains NO secrets. Each Code below needs a matching read-only SQL connection string in 'dotnet user-secrets' as CompanyConnectionStrings:{Code} (development) or CompanyConnectionStrings__{Code} env var (production). See README section 4.
// SapServiceLayer note: AllowInvalidCertificate must stay false here (production/default). It is set true only in appsettings.Development.json, for a local Service Layer's self-signed certificate.

Jwt.// Key: Set via user-secrets (Jwt:Key) or env var Jwt__Key. Minimum 32 random characters.

// SalesTurnover: Per company: location (Unit) names left unticked by default in Sales Overview -> Total Turnover. Users can still tick them. Names match ignoring case and spaces.
// SalesDashboard: Per company: the named units on the Sales Dashboard. Location = the SAP location (OLCT) used for sales; Branch = the SAP branch (OBPL) used for journal outstanding. Matched by name (ignoring case/spaces). Branch names marked TO CONFIRM were inferred from the branch list and must be confirmed with the client; leave Branch empty where no mapping exists.
